description: Windows window chrome — the window has no OS title bar (decorations: false), so the app draws minimize · maximize/restore and tells the native window its light/dark theme (the 1px top edge and the system menu are drawn by the OS in the window's theme). Close goes through the close_window command (its CloseRequested guard asks about running terminal sessions). macOS keeps the OS traffic lights and Linux the native bar, so neither gets these.
